title: Downtown Riverfront Condo-1st Floor-River View
description:
Beautiful view of the river with great location where you can watch the boats go by! Walking distance along the river or short Uber ride (approx $6-$8) to Nissan/Titans Stadium, Ascend Amphitheater, Bridgestone Arena, Ryman, Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, Honky Tonks, Nashville Sounds, Germantown and more! Grocery Stores nearby: Publix 1010 Dr. Martin L. Luther King Blvd., Kroger 800 Monroe St. , Farmer's Market, 900 Rosa L. Parks Blvd, (fresh vegetables, restaurants, desserts, vendors).

The space
Riverfront views. Easy access to sporting events and entertainment. 

Bedroom: 1 Queen Bed

Kitchen: Fully equipped with pots and pans, dishes, coffee maker, coffee, tea.

Bathroom: Towels, toilet paper, shampoo, conditioner, lotion, bath gel/soap, hair dryer. 

Living Room: Couch, loveseat, dining table and chairs.

Guest access
Internet and TV with antenna. 

Complimentary covered parking.  

Pool is under construction due to tornado in March 2020. We are unsure when repairs will be complete. 

Workout facility.

Washer/dryer available in the laundry building.

Other things to note
This condo is a hidden gem!  Great views of the Cumberland River with easy access to the busy area  of downtown, but much quieter.   Everything is close by--a great location.

During CMA Fest in June, the minimum rental is for four (4) nights-you can walk or take a short Uber ride to everything CMA Fest, including Titans stadium and downtown!
